name: @shbernal/rampkit-cli
description: CLI and interactive TUI for generating Tailwind-style color ramps with rampkit.
author: shbernal <shbernal.01@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format esm --splitting --outdir dist --external react-devtools-core --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/main.js
